project.title: Launch of Tiered Membership Program for Key Customer Segments
project.objective: Design and roll out a new tiered membership program to increase retention and upsell opportunities across priority customer segments.
deliverables: Tiered membership structure with benefits, pricing, and eligibility rules
End-to-end membership operations playbook for sales and membership teams
Updated membership database fields and reporting definitions
Launch campaign plan for existing and new members
Standard scripts and FAQs for handling member queries and complaints
constraints: Program must be launch-ready within 21 days
No changes to core billing platform; only configuration and process changes allowed
Compliance with data protection and marketing consent policies
Membership benefits must be margin-positive within 6 months
Sales incentives must align with existing compensation framework

risks.risk: Overly complex tier structure confuses members and staff.
risks.mitigation: Limit to 3 tiers, validate with quick internal pilot and adjust based on feedback.

risks.risk: Sales team oversells benefits or miscommunicates eligibility.
risks.mitigation: Provide clear scripts, quick reference guides, and mandatory briefing sessions.

risks.risk: Data quality issues in existing membership database impact targeting and reporting.
risks.mitigation: Run pre-launch data audit and define minimum data standards and clean-up tasks.

risks.risk: Benefits erode margins due to underestimated usage.
risks.mitigation: Model scenarios with finance and set caps/conditions on high-cost benefits.

themes.why_relevant: Defines how attractive and understandable the new membership offer is.
Both teams must execute consistently for a smooth launch.
Accurate tracking is needed to measure uptake and retention impact.
Clear messaging reduces complaints and churn risk.
Ensures issues are handled quickly without disrupting daily operations.

backlog.task: Define membership tiers, benefits, and pricing for three key customer segments
definition_of_done: Three tiers documented with clear eligibility rules and pricing
Benefits list validated with finance for margin impact
Tier overview shared with sales manager for feedback

backlog.task: Design sales pitch framework and objection-handling guide for new tiers
definition_of_done: Pitch outline created for each tier
Top 10 objections with recommended responses documented
Guide reviewed and approved by membership manager

backlog.task: Create membership operations playbook covering onboarding, upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations
definition_of_done: Process flows documented for all key membership lifecycle events
Roles and responsibilities clarified for sales and membership teams
Playbook shared with stakeholders and feedback incorporated

backlog.task: Define data fields and tagging rules in membership database for new tiers
definition_of_done: List of required fields and values finalized
Tagging rules for tiers and segments documented
Data standards agreed with sales manager and customer service manager

backlog.task: Plan and schedule internal training sessions for sales and membership teams
definition_of_done: Training agenda and materials drafted
Training dates confirmed with team leads
Attendance tracking approach agreed

backlog.task: Draft external launch communication plan for existing members
definition_of_done: Key messages and offers per segment defined
Preferred channels and timing outlined
Plan validated with membership manager and marketing manager

backlog.task: Prepare FAQ and escalation matrix for customer service and front-line staff
definition_of_done: FAQ covers at least 30 common questions
Escalation paths and SLAs defined
Document shared with customer service manager for sign-off

backlog.task: Run quick audit of current membership data quality for target segments
definition_of_done: Data completeness and accuracy report produced
Key issues and root causes summarized
Priority clean-up actions identified and assigned

backlog.task: Define sales targets and simple incentive rules linked to new tiers
definition_of_done: Tier-specific sales targets drafted
Incentive rules aligned with existing compensation framework
Proposal reviewed with finance manager

backlog.task: Pilot new membership tiers with a small group of existing members
definition_of_done: Pilot cohort and duration defined
Feedback collection method agreed
Pilot results summarized with recommendations

backlog.task: Align cross-team launch timeline and key milestones
definition_of_done: Milestone plan covering design, training, pilot, and full launch created
Dependencies between sales and membership tasks mapped
Timeline approved by all key stakeholders

backlog.task: Set up weekly performance review cadence for first 8 weeks post-launch
definition_of_done: Core KPIs and reporting cadence defined
Meeting format and participants agreed
First two review dates scheduled
